# Anthony Smith

> Senior Software Engineer with 15+ years building production systems, specializing in application and API security. Open to full-time roles and contract or freelance work. Based in Grand Rapids, Michigan, US.

Knows about application security, API security, the OWASP API Security Top 10, React Native, TypeScript, Supabase, and AI and LLM integrations. Google Ads and Analytics certified. CompTIA PenTest+ certified.

## What I do
- [What I do](https://anthonysdigital.net/#what-i-do): 15+ years building production systems across web, iOS, SaaS, and databases.
- Ships React Native and TypeScript mobile apps on Supabase that use the OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini APIs, including [CastLog](https://castlogapp.com/), [Nutrilogix](https://nutrilogix-ai.com/), and [VoiceLift](https://voicelift.app/).
- API and application security focus: BOLA, rate limiting, and prompt injection, with OWASP-aligned secure coding.
- [CallCatch](https://anthonys1760.github.io/callcatch-landing/) answers from a business's own website, does not invent a price, and turns unanswered questions into leads. [Rogue River Labs](https://rogueriverlabs.dev/) builds mobile apps and the APIs behind them, and finds where access checks break.
- Open to full-time roles and to contract or freelance work.

## Selected work
- [Selected work](https://anthonysdigital.net/#selected-work): CastLog — React Native / Expo + TypeScript fishing journal with voice-first logging, offline-first (lake, weather, and moon phase, including with no signal), and Supabase. iOS is on the App Store, and an [Android beta](https://castlogapp.com/#android-invite) is open. Nutrilogix — React Native / Expo + TypeScript nutrition app with photo or voice meal logging, barcode lookup, Apple Health sync, and Supabase. The iOS TestFlight beta is open.

## FAQ
- [FAQ](https://anthonysdigital.net/#faq): What kind of work does Anthony Smith do? He has 15+ years building production systems across web, iOS, SaaS, and databases. He ships React Native and TypeScript mobile apps on Supabase that use the OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini APIs.
- Is he open to full-time work or contract work? Both. He is open to full-time roles and to contract or freelance work.
- What stack does he use? React Native, TypeScript, and Supabase for mobile apps, plus web, iOS, SaaS, and database work. Those apps use the OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini APIs. He is Google Ads and Analytics certified, and CompTIA PenTest+ certified.
- What products has he shipped? He has shipped CastLog, Nutrilogix, VoiceLift, and CallCatch. CallCatch answers from a business's own website and is a Rogue River Labs product. Rogue River Labs builds mobile apps and the APIs behind them, and finds where access checks break.
- What security experience does he have? He focuses on API and application security, including BOLA, rate limiting, and prompt injection, and on OWASP-aligned secure coding. He is CompTIA PenTest+ certified and writes about testing the OWASP API Security Top 10.

## Products
- [CastLog](https://castlogapp.com/): Voice-first fishing journal. Say the catch and it logs the lake, weather, and moon phase, including offline. iOS is on the App Store, and an Android test is open.
- [Nutrilogix](https://nutrilogix-ai.com/): AI nutrition tracking. Snap a plate or say what you ate to log calories and macros, and sync workouts from Apple Health. The iOS beta is open.
- [VoiceLift](https://voicelift.app/): Voice-first workout logging. Say a set and it is logged, including gym slang, supersets, and partials. A waitlist is open.
- [CallCatch](https://anthonys1760.github.io/callcatch-landing/): Answers from a business's own website, does not invent a price, and turns unanswered questions into leads. A Rogue River Labs product for HVAC, plumbing, and electrical companies.
- [Rogue River Labs](https://rogueriverlabs.dev/): Builds mobile apps and the APIs behind them, and finds where access checks break. Founded by Anthony Smith.
- [Portfolio](https://anthonysdigital.net/portfolio.html): Selected work, including CastLog, Nutrilogix, VoiceLift, CallCatch, and Rogue River Labs.
